open_points.subject: admit_implementation
open_points.text: - admit_implementation: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] An admitted verdict activates the implementation by the kernel in the same request unless it already is the contract version's current activation, read with current_activation before the verdict is written: a new verdict sets activate true in its change exactly when it is admitted and the implementation is not that current activation, otherwise false and the current Activation is the one returned; a reused admitted verdict of an implementation that is not the current activation writes one RecordActivationChange through record_change; a refused verdict activates nothing and leaves the current activation serving.
open_points.other_text: - admit_implementation: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST return a SubmissionResult with the implementation, the new or reused verdict, and when admitted the current Activation, new or existing, otherwise None.
open_points.question: For a new refused verdict, does “otherwise false and the current Activation is the one returned” require returning the existing current Activation, or must the returned activation be None as the RETURN_SHAPE requires?
